cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import json, random
rng = random.Random(55)
n = 48
links = []
for u in range(n): links.append((u,(u+1)%n))
while len(links) < 128:
    u=rng.randrange(n); v=rng.randrange(n)
    if u!=v and (u,v) not in links and (v,u) not in links: links.append((u,v))
caps=[1000]*len(links)
lines=[{'op':'load','n':n,'links':[[u,v,c] for (u,v),c in zip(links,caps)],'bookings':[]}]
parts=rng.sample(range(n),32)
r={v: rng.randint(1,1000) for v in parts}
env=[[l, 50] for l in range(len(links))]
for i in range(120):
    lines.append({'op':'advance','time': i})
    lines.append({'op':'audit','at':[i, i+1]})
lines.append({'op':'prepare','id':'Q1','owner':'own','window':[120,120+10**6],'period':10**6,
  'participants':[[v,r[v]] for v in parts],'envelope':env,'rev':len(lines)-1+0})
lines.append({'op':'commit','id':'Q1','owner':'own','rev':0})
open('long.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(json.dumps(x) for x in lines)+'\n')
print('lines',len(lines))
" && time (python3 -I -B /workspace/submission/main.py < long.jsonl > long.out; wc -l long.out; tail -c 300 long.out)
